description: Multi-OEM Android bloatware, telemetry, and security risk database

com.samsung.android.sm.devicesecurity.name: McAfee Device Security Scanner
com.samsung.android.sm.devicesecurity.impact: Consumes 10-15% background CPU constantly, causes battery drain and thermal throttling.

com.samsung.android.game.gamehome.name: Game Launcher
com.samsung.android.game.gamehome.impact: Ad delivery, promotional push notifications, and background monitoring.

com.samsung.android.game.gametools.name: Game Tools
com.samsung.android.game.gametools.impact: Floating overlay hooks and touch tracking.

com.samsung.android.voc.name: Samsung Members
com.samsung.android.voc.impact: Feedback, community notices, and diagnostic data uploads.

com.samsung.android.aremoji.name: AR Emoji
com.samsung.android.aremoji.impact: 3D AR avatar assets consuming ~120MB storage and background camera services.

com.samsung.android.bixby.agent.name: Bixby Voice Agent
com.samsung.android.bixby.agent.impact: Voice recognition background wakelocks and audio daemon.

com.samsung.android.app.reminder.name: Samsung Reminder
com.samsung.android.app.reminder.impact: Safe to disable if using Google Keep or another calendar/reminder app.

com.osp.app.signin.name: Samsung Account
com.osp.app.signin.impact: CRITICAL: Do NOT disable. Required for Samsung Cloud, Find My Mobile, and Galaxy Store.

com.wssyncmldm.name: Samsung Software Update (OTA)
com.wssyncmldm.impact: CRITICAL: Do NOT disable. Manages official firmware updates and security patches.

com.microsoft.appmanager.name: Microsoft Link to Windows
com.microsoft.appmanager.impact: Known severe bug: Loops at 131% CPU in background, causing intense heat and stutter.

com.heytap.mcs.name: HeyTap Push Notification Service
com.heytap.mcs.impact: Generates 100+ wakeups every 5 minutes, preventing deep sleep (disable if not using HeyTap Cloud).

com.oplus.statistics.rom.name: ColorOS Telemetry & Usage Analytics
com.oplus.statistics.rom.impact: Uploads user statistics every 30 mins, consuming ~122MB RAM.

com.oplus.onetrace.name: Systrace Performance Profiler
com.oplus.onetrace.impact: Continuous kernel tracing and diagnostic logging consuming ~117MB RAM.

com.oplus.deepthinker.name: AI Habit & Touch Prediction Engine
com.oplus.deepthinker.impact: Intercepts app launches and touch events to train local models (~112MB RAM).

com.oplus.commercial.name: Commercial Ad Delivery Framework
com.oplus.commercial.impact: Fetches promotional banners and recommended apps in system folders.

com.oplus.crashbox.name: Crashbox Dump Collector
com.oplus.crashbox.impact: Continuous crash dump file writes to internal storage.

com.oplus.qualityprotect.name: Quality Protection Telemetry
com.oplus.qualityprotect.impact: Background telemetry uploading hardware health metrics.

com.oplus.ota.name: Realme / ColorOS OTA Update Engine
com.oplus.ota.impact: CRITICAL: Do NOT disable. Handles official system upgrades and security patches.

com.oplus.romupdate.name: ROM Update Signature Verifier
com.oplus.romupdate.impact: CRITICAL: Do NOT disable. Verifies security patch integrity.

com.oplus.account.name: Realme / HeyTap Account
com.oplus.account.impact: CRITICAL: Do NOT disable if you rely on HeyTap Cloud backup and account sync.

com.miui.msa.global.name: MIUI System Ads (MSA)
com.miui.msa.global.impact: Pushes system banner ads across stock apps and consumes background mobile data.

com.miui.analytics.name: MIUI Analytics Daemon
com.miui.analytics.impact: Harvests application usage patterns and device diagnostic telemetry.

com.xiaomi.joyose.name: Joyose Performance Throttling Service
com.xiaomi.joyose.impact: Known for aggressive CPU/GPU thermal down-throttling in games and benchmark tampering.

com.miui.daemon.name: MIUI System Daemon
com.miui.daemon.impact: Background analytics collector and log generator.

com.miui.hybrid.name: Quick Apps / Hybrid Framework
com.miui.hybrid.impact: Ad delivery engine for instant mini-programs.

com.miui.cleanmaster.name: CleanMaster Adware Engine
com.miui.cleanmaster.impact: Third-party cleaner engine bundled with ads and privacy concerns.

com.android.updater.name: Xiaomi System Updater
com.android.updater.impact: CRITICAL: Do NOT disable. Handles HyperOS/MIUI system OTA updates.

com.facebook.katana.name: Facebook Stub / Pre-installed App
com.facebook.katana.impact: OEM system pre-install with deep background wakelocks.

com.facebook.system.name: Facebook App Installer
com.facebook.system.impact: Silent background app updater for Meta apps without Play Store interaction.

com.facebook.appmanager.name: Facebook App Manager
com.facebook.appmanager.impact: Persistent background service tracking app usage metrics.

com.google.android.webview.name: Android System WebView
com.google.android.webview.impact: Renders web content inside banking, shopping, and browser apps.

com.android.systemui.name: System UI
com.android.systemui.impact: Status bar, notification shade, and navigation bar compositor.

com.android.phone.name: Phone / Telephony Service
com.android.phone.impact: Cellular radio, SIM management, and 911/112 emergency calls.
